title: Bihar MP speaks to Fadnavis in Marathi, aids Maha pilgrims in language of love
desc: A video of Sitamarhi MP Devesh Chandra Thakur speaking in fluent Marathi while hosting over 100 pilgrims from Maharashtra who had escaped flood-hit Nepal and crossed into Bihar has gone viral. In another video, he was seen speaking to Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis in Marathi. How did the Bihar MP become so fluent in Marathi, and is there a message in times of Marathi imposition?
